Run stm init, schedule list, tasks list, and projects show from fresh CLI processes; all must exit 0 without requiring an LLM key.
Confirm the same pending twice from two callers (or double-click) and verify only one schedule item lands and the second confirm reports the item is already handled.
Via CLI recall a query with no matching notes; verify the answer is not_found with empty citations rather than an unsourced claim.
